"""Render fixed V168 native views with V169 balanced/branch diagnostics."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont

from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

REPO=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'


def render():
    plan=read(ROOT/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
    result=read(ROOT/'scores-v1.json');assert result['component_forwards']==result['original_predictions_replayed_exact']==1644
    prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);out=ROOT/'figures-v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',10)
    figures=[];channels=0;copied_channels=0
    for index,item in enumerate(prior['images']):
        assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image']
        old=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));case=item['case'];a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']))
        anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1);values=result['native_predictions'][case['id']]
        sources=[];bindings={}
        def copied(panel,label=None):
            nonlocal copied_channels
            x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
            sources.append((label or panel['label'],old[y:y+h,x:x+w].copy()));copied_channels+=w*h*3
        def predicted(method):
            nonlocal channels
            binding=values[method];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
            value=np.load(binding['path']);displayed=anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor)
            actual=pixels(displayed,a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure'])
            expected=independent_display(displayed,a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual,expected)
            assert actual.shape==(160,160,3);channels+=actual.size
            sources.append((method,actual));bindings[method]=binding
        if 'triplet_source_board' in item:
            label=item['panels'][1]['label']
            endpoint='EMA' if 'EMA' in label else 'raw'
            method=('balanced' if label.startswith('Fine mesh') else 'spectral-only')+'-'+endpoint
            copied(item['panels'][0]);predicted(method);copied(item['panels'][-1])
        else:
            mapping={p['label']:p for p in item['panels']}
            for name,label in [('Noisy Malvar',None),('V143 parent',None),('Fine mesh raw1k','V168 raw'),('Fine mesh EMA1k','V168 EMA')]:copied(mapping[name],label)
            for method in ['balanced-raw','balanced-EMA','spectral-only-raw','spectral-only-EMA','spatial-only-raw','spatial-only-EMA']:predicted(method)
            for panel in item['panels']:
                if panel['label'].startswith('V161') or panel['label'] in ['Periodic detail','Exact constructed GT','ISO100 AHD, not GT','ISO6400 JPEG native','ISO100 JPEG, not GT']:copied(panel)
        board=Image.new('RGB',(8+168*len(sources),212),'#eeeeee');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text((8,4),f"{case['id']} | V169 fixed weights,contrast{item['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{item['exposure']:g}",font=font,fill='black')
        panels=[]
        for j,(label,value) in enumerate(sources):
            x=8+168*j;draw.text((x,26),label,font=font,fill='black');board.paste(Image.fromarray(value),(x,44));panels.append(dict(label=label,xywh=[x,44,160,160]))
        path=out/f'comparison-{index:02d}.png';board.save(path)
        check=np.asarray(Image.open(path))
        for panel,(_,value) in zip(panels,sources,strict=True):
            x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];np.testing.assert_array_equal(check[y:y+h,x:x+w],value)
        figures.append(dict(case=case,ROI_xywh=item['ROI_xywh'],anchor=item['anchor'],contrast=item['contrast'],exposure=item['exposure'],
            image=ref(path),panels=panels,predictions=bindings,source_figure=item['image'],no_resize=True,
            triplet='triplet_source_board' in item))
    assert len(figures)==72 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in figures)==24
    sheets=[]
    for n in range(18):
        group=figures[n*4:n*4+4];width=max(Image.open(i['image']['path']).width for i in group)
        sheet=Image.new('RGB',(width,848),'#eeeeee')
        for j,item in enumerate(group):sheet.paste(Image.open(item['image']['path']),(0,j*212))
        path=out/f'sheet-{n:02d}.png';sheet.save(path);sheets.append(dict(indices=list(range(n*4,n*4+4)),image=ref(path),no_resize=True))
    save(ROOT/'figures-v1.json',dict(status='rendered-awaiting-actual-original-detail-viewing',plan=ref(ROOT/'plan-v1.json'),scores=ref(ROOT/'scores-v1.json'),
        images=figures,sheets=sheets,new_RGB_channels_independently_checked=channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_copied_exact=copied_channels,
        no_resize=True,native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,renderer=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
    print('Rendered72 native figures/24triplets;new channels',channels,'copied',copied_channels)


if __name__=='__main__':render()
